<subject>Hey Darren</subject>
<body>
It's me, Laurie Hicks. I just thought I would drop you a line and say hello!!! How are you?

I sure hated to hear about the incident at the [MINE_SITE]. I don't understand how something like that can happen to such an all around great person.

Hope to hear from you!!

Laurie
